slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within a month, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary uses an end-of-month inventory balance without confirming whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, or at least that intra-month purchase timing does not affect the inventory capacity constraint.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked when purchases occur within the month, but the READY_TO_MODEL model uses I_m = I_{m-1} + x_m − s_m and I_m ≤ 500, which implicitly assumes a monthly timing convention for purchases.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it failed to ask about the timing of purchases within each month, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved and silently assuming a monthly inventory-balance convention.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
